_comment: [CHANGE: claude-code | 2026-07-25] Hooks run under a NON-INTERACTIVE shell where PATH is only /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin. ~/.local/bin is added by ~/.zshrc, which such shells never source, so bare 'code-review-graph' resolved to nothing and BOTH hooks silently failed on every invocation. Always use absolute paths here. --repo is explicit because hook cwd is not guaranteed.
